section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. All data for this comparison were collected at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 6. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 213 | 800 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Side effects | 153 | 800 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Side effects | 298 | 800 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
